news.title: Saudi Eyes 10 Million Barrels a Day of Oil Pipe Capacity
news.summary: Saudi Arabia is looking at ways to expand its oil pipeline capacity to destinations outside the Persian Gulf to 10 million barrels a day within two to three years, said Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman.
